credential_inventory.purpose: Authenticate ISO Smart integration requests to AdminApps
credential_inventory.credential_type: Long-lived service API key sent in X-API-Key
credential_inventory.persistence: Persistent service credential supplied through ADMIN_APPS_API_KEY; not ephemeral
credential_inventory.historical_evidence_source: docs/governance/evidence/phase31_5/01_environment.json records a hard-coded development AdminApps integration credential fallback in backend/backend/settings.py
credential_inventory.rotation_mechanism: Revoke the old key and issue a replacement in the AdminApps credential authority; install it only through an approved secret-injection mechanism

credential_inventory.purpose: Bootstrap an initial ISO Smart administrator
credential_inventory.persistence: A password credential could persist in the target account store if the historical bootstrap path was used; current use is unverified
credential_inventory.historical_evidence_source: docs/governance/evidence/phase31_5/01_environment.json records a hard-coded initial administrator password and credential-print path
credential_inventory.rotation_mechanism: Verify whether the affected account exists and, if it may have used the committed value, reset/revoke it through the authorized ISO Smart account authority

credential_inventory.purpose: Authenticate one readiness request using an eligible run-scoped identity
credential_inventory.authority_provider: AdminApps programmatic SimpleJWT issuance using the existing shared SSO signing subsystem
credential_inventory.persistence: Ephemeral; 900-second lifetime, anonymous pipe handoff, mutable in-memory buffer, no persisted refresh credential, fingerprint-only evidence
credential_inventory.rotation_mechanism: Not applicable to this short-lived access token; the underlying AdminApps API key is adjudicated separately
credential_inventory.qualification: Expiry of an ephemeral bearer is not authority-backed rotation of the underlying long-lived credential.

repository_scan.method: Targeted rg high-confidence scan; gitleaks and trufflehog are unavailable locally
patterns: quoted literal assignments to password, API-key, secret, or token identifiers
repository_scan.tracked_source_interpretation: No high-confidence literal credential candidate was found in the bounded E-07 source files. This does not erase documented historical exposure or establish rotation.

ignored_local_environment.reason: Ignored local environment file was not opened or copied into evidence.

prior_scan_evidence.scanner: git grep high-confidence patterns; gitleaks unavailable locally

history_scan.history_method: Git log inspected path/commit metadata only; no historical credential values were emitted or copied
history_scan.qualification: The cited path commits bound relevant source history, not proof that a credential was rotated or that a particular commit was the first exposure.

rotation_evidence.required_follow_up: AdminApps authority must revoke the old key, issue and safely install a replacement, then provide redacted authority event metadata, safe fingerprints/timestamps, old-key rejection proof, and a narrow authorized identity/readiness acceptance proof.

An authorized ISO Smart account administrator must determine whether the affected account/value was used and, if so, reset or revoke it; provide redacted event metadata and old-credential rejection proof without disclosing either password.

rotation_evidence.evidence: Source contract documents 900-second issuance, pipe/in-memory handling, teardown overwrite, token_persisted=false, and fingerprint-only evidence.
rotation_evidence.qualification: This short-lived token does not satisfy or replace rotation proof for ADMIN_APPS_API_KEY.

blockers.required_evidence: Authority-side revocation and replacement records, safe old/new fingerprints and timestamps, old-key rejection, and replacement acceptance through a narrow approved check

blockers.blocked_authority: Authorized ISO Smart account administrator/target account store
blockers.required_evidence: Account-use determination, reset/revocation record if applicable, and old-password rejection evidence; no password values

publication.method: Normal non-force commit and push, subject to staged-diff secret review
publication.commit_and_upstream_synchronization: To be verified from Git metadata after publication; no self-referential commit hash stored in this artifact.
